data.nsfwProse: Her sleeveless white ruffled dress with its small red ribbon is slipped down around her waist, leaving her breasts bare while her free hand touches herself between her thighs.
data.promptProse: Seen from a low angle in a quiet tatami room bordered by shoji screens, Ikaros sits astride a floor cushion steadying her wing root with one hand. Warm paper-lantern glow mingles with a soft blue pulse from her chest across her flushed face and white feathers.

data.animaCaption: Sitting astride a tatami floor cushion with her white angeloid dress lowered off her bare chest, she steadies the base of one white wing with one hand and slips the other between her thighs where soft blue core light meets the warm paper lantern.
